testcase.name: only a completed purge allows the auth user to be deleted
an incomplete purge keeps the account and carries the counts
the dialog copy never claims success before the server does
a stale session is reported as a re-authentication request, not a failure
an expired session, an unreachable server and an unknown error are all failures
the client never deletes the auth user before the server purge
deletion no longer wipes local data before the server agrees
